messages:
maria: FYI - Atlas Retail paused their POC until we can provide a KMS attestation and a short commercial commitment for the pilot. CISO asked for a signed attestation or a run-of-record for BYOK import. they want an exec touchpoint tomorrow morning. can we assemble?

alex: can you forward the exact attestation language they want? sometimes a vendor-signed statement + key handling diagram suffices.

maria: copied from their mail: "require vendor attestation that private keys are only wrapped and that Redwood never persists plaintext keys; proof of HSM-backed wrapping and import process; SOC2 evidence optional but helpful". attaching the thread: https://drive.internal/atlas/attest-email

rachel: engineering note 1 - for hosted we only do envelope wrapping; we can provide an import flow for private where keys never leave customer's HSM. we can produce a short attestation doc but ops needs to confirm wording.

tom: ops can produce a templated attestation. need to know if they want kernel-level measurement (TPM/EPID) or just HSM signing metadata. which do they ask?

maria: they mentioned "HSM-backed wrapping" and "host attestation". sounds like they want both.

leah: commercial input 1 - customer wants a spend cap for the quarter and an option to pause. suggest offering a capped hosted trial with a $40k credit and a 15% introductory discount if they sign an SOW for a 90-day pilot. need approval from revenue leader for discounts >10%.

alex: technical workaround for tomorrow: offer a provisional attestation template with placeholders for HSM serial and import logs; follow up with formal attestation within 5 business days after a private deployment validation. that keeps the POC moving.

maria: can ops draft provis attestation tonight? we'll present it on the exec bridge.

tom: yes, i'll draft a provisional attestation. will call out caveats and formal delivery timeline.

ops-bot: provisional attestation draft created -> https://ops.internal/attestations/atlas-provisional-draft (auto) :white_check_mark:

rachel: network ask - for a private deployment we also need their peering details and a small fw rule list. pls get CIDR allowlist + maintenance window.

leah: commercial ask - if revenue signs off, i can commit to the $40k credit + 15% pilot discount. any objections?

alex: no objections. confirm revenue lead signoff before we finalize.

maria: schedule: exec bridge tomorrow 10:00am PT. attendees: maria (AE), leah (rev), tom (ops), alex (eng), rachel (infra), atlas CISO + VP eng. pre-brief 9:15am PT w/ Redwood team.

maria: action owners: tom -> provisional attestation (draft link above), alex -> technical talking points re: BYOK import safety, rachel -> network checklist, leah -> pricing terms and credit approval, maria -> customer invite + pre-read. target: all artifacts in pre-read 60m before pre-brief.

maria: one last note from customer: they asked whether logs can be forwarded into their SIEM with 7-day retention and who owns the audit logs. reply prepared: yes - log forwarding supported for private and dedicated, retention configurable; audit logs retained per DPA. i'll confirm on the bridge.

leah: tagging revenue: @vic please approve POC credit & discount mentioned above before pre-brief.

maria: closing thread for now. i'll reopen after the pre-brief and post notes.
